final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), scored AS (SELECT telescref, avg_modindex, AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS overall_avg FROM per_telescope) SELECT telescref, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_overall, avg_modindex / overall_avg AS ratio FROM scored WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
